t: This is the site of the former West London Hospital. It began in 1856 as the Fulham and Hammersmith General Dispensary, in a small six-roomed building in Queen Street, Hammersmith. It treated acute conditions, and in later years it also cared for geriatric, maternity, rehabilitation and long-stay patients. Two people who died here are on record. Arthur Alkin Sykes was a British teacher, civil servant, journalist and author who lived from 1861 to 1939. Emma Ellen Kettley, born in 1861, died here in 1914.
